text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 4) 2022.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 20 Oktober 2022 hingga 26 Oktober 2022.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing biri-biri bertulang import

2. Tomato

3. Cili merah

4. Kacang dal (Australia)

Dibuat 7 Oktober 2022

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 4) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5

of the Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 4) Order 2022.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 20 October 2022 to 26 October 2022.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported bone-in mutton

2. Tomato

3. Red chilli

4. Dhal (Australia)

Made 7 October 2022

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs
